experimental: Desktop automation uses agent-desktop with headless accessibility actions. Browser automation uses agent-browser in a separate browser session. Stop active actions with Alt+Shift+Escape.
alert: Actovia uses the open-source agent-desktop and agent-browser engines. Desktop control is off by default and limited to the running apps you allow below. Browser tasks use their own private session. The AI observes, acts and checks the result with your selected model.

enable.label: Enable Computer Use
enable.description: Let the AI drive an allowlisted window.

allowlist.label: Allowlisted apps
allowlist.description: Desktop control only touches these apps. Choose from the running apps on this computer.

maxSteps.label: Max steps
maxSteps.description: Maximum desktop observations and actions per agent run. Default 25.

settleDelay.label: Settle delay (ms)
settleDelay.description: Wait this long after each action before the next screenshot. Default 800.

enabled.label: Enable Browser Use
enabled.description: Allow browser tasks in a private session, separate from your personal browser. Turning this off blocks the next action; sessions can still close.

headed.label: Show browser window
headed.description: Show the automated browser so you can follow its actions. Applies to new sessions; off runs without a visible window.

maxSteps.label: Browser actions per run
maxSteps.description: Maximum browser calls in one agent run. Closing remains available after the limit. Default 100.
